items.title: Sporty Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
No point in sitting around the house all day, you need to stay active! These teens will help you out by playing soccer, basketball and more!

*13 sporty teens
*2 free skins

items.title: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker Race
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Do you want to play as a hacker with your friends to troll them and race epic races against them? You can start with a small dirt house or in the beautiful mansion of the hacker. It includes overpowered items that will give you an unfair advantage in the game. But don't forget the pro! He has some tricks up his sleeve!

+ 3 vehicles
+ 1 free skin
+ By RareLoot

items.title: Lucky Blocks 2.1
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
LUCKY BLOCKS are back! Enchanted tools and items, snow golems or a horde of zombies, anything is possible.
Move into a modern mansion, explore custom biomes and break a lot of Lucky Blocks!

+ Have fun playing!

(The Lucky Blocks are only useable with the world provided!)
items.changelog:
- Updated the Lucky Blocks with new drops and summons up to version 26.0
- Added a new pale garden island to the world

items.title: One Block Advanced
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: One block is not enough! Break 13 custom regenerative 'one blocks' in a custom skyblock world. With a block focused on each biome, break one to gear up and survive!

items.title: Craftable Skyblock
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Craftable Skyblocks! You can craft 10 different skyblock islands and place them indefinitely! There are several sky block islands that have something special, such as a castle, volcano, medieval house, tree house and much more! Ready to play some skyblock?

+SKYBLOCK!
+Custom crafting recipes!
+Including 10 skyblock islands!

items.title: Airport Tycoon
items.creator: Doctor Benx
items.description:
Be the manager of your very own airport. Unlock 30 different upgrades and enjoy the included free skins and animated models while you watch your empire grow bigger as you earn more and more money by taking care of security and even flying planes yourself!
-Animated models
-Custom planes
-30 upgrades
-Designed for 1-2 players
-By DoctorBenx and oectway
items.changelog: Updated everything to the newest Minecraft Version. Fixed all known bugs.

items.title: Spring Castle
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Welcome to Spring Castle! Explore a cute, chill village beside a big bright castle full of fun places to discover. 
Relax, explore, and enjoy a friendly world made for adventure!
=> Find chests with hidden treasures
=> Enjoy a survival spawn adventure with friends
=> Role-play friendly for multiplayer and single player
=> 4 royal skins
=> One free skin included
items.changelog:
=> Vibrant Visuals compatible
=> Map improvements and bug fixes
